import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/proteomic_data.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wb['Tumor vs Normal']

# Find ENO1 in gene column (column C, index 2)
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    if row[2] and str(row[2]).strip() == 'ENO1':
        print(f'Found ENO1:')
        print(f'  protein: {row[0]}')
        print(f'  Description: {row[1]}')
        print(f'  gene: {row[2]}')
        print(f'  gene_id: {row[3]}')
        print(f'  Normal: {row[4]}')
        print(f'  Tumor: {row[5]}')
        print(f'  Ratio: {row[6]}')
        print(f'  FC: {row[7]}')
        print(f'  log2FC: {row[8]}')
        print(f'  p.value: {row[9]}')
        print(f'  adj.Pval: {row[10]}')
        print(f'  is_sig: {row[11]}')
        print(f'  compare: {row[12]}')
        break
else:
    # Try case-insensitive
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
        if row[2] and str(row[2]).strip().upper() == 'ENO1':
            print(f'Found ENO1 (case-insensitive):')
            print(f'  gene: {row[2]}')
            print(f'  log2FC: {row[8]}')
            break
    else:
        print('ENO1 not found in gene column')
"
